what: The corpus for outside reruns (phase 2 of the rerun program, 2026-10-02): ten rows of the claims register chosen for one property — a party outside this lab has a reason to re-derive them and the means to do it in a line. Five parties, each with a drafted ask (outreach/rerun-asks-2026-10-02.md); every ask is a send on the operator's per-item word. The milestone is measured, never declared: a party counts when corpus/external-reruns.json holds a row of theirs whose `rows` names one of these ids. The line each row runs is the kit's, by its record (corpus/rerun-kit.json); nothing is repeated here.
milestone: five independent parties obtain the same verdicts on this corpus — or record where they do not
